newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mercantile Mutual profit up 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mercantile Mutual profit up 18 pct.

text.p: Financial services group Mercantile Mutual said on Monday it had increased profit after tax for the year to September 31 by 18 percent to A$71.1 million.
Group assets under management rose 38 percent to A$11.9 billion, the group said in a statement.
Mercantile Mutual is a unit of Dutch insurance and banking group Internationale Nederlanden Groep NV.
The increase came from general insurance operations, which posted a 70 percent rise in profit after tax to A$70 million.
Profit after tax for life and funds management operations fell slightly to A$36 million, from A$37 million previously.
ING Mercantile Mutual Bank, owned by Mercantile Mutual and the banking operation of the ING Group, recorded an after tax profit of A$5.5 million, up 14 percent.
Mercantile Mutual managing director Rod Atfield said the group had achieved strong organic growth, as well as making several strategic acquisitions.
Atfield said the group results did not include the operations of the recently acquired Pacific Mutual group.
